theme_strategy.rationale: App is an established internal ops tool/CRM (Agrocorp CRM) with a predefined warm off-white and near-black identity. Maintains high focus, clarity, and reading comfort for data-dense dashboards.

rules.labels: text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--color-gray-500);

visual_enhancers.spacing: Use base-4 scale. Generous padding inside cards (24px or 32px) to let data breathe.

layouts.grid_system: CSS Grid for the main dashboard wrapper. 12-column layout.
layouts.container_css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 24px; padding: 32px; max-width: 1600px; margin: 0 auto;

regions.kpi_row: grid-column: span 12; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px;
regions.middle_right_graphs: grid-column: span 4; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px;
regions.bottom_right_calendar_activity: grid-column: span 4; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 24px;

kpi_cards.layout: Minimalist rectangular cards. No thick shadows, rely on 1px borders.
kpi_cards.structure: Top: Label + Icon. Middle: Massive Number (font-weight: 800, text-4xl). Bottom: Delta pill (Lime for positive +X%, Gray for neutral).
kpi_cards.hover: Subtle Y-axis lift (transform: translateY(-2px)) and shadow increase.

top_prospects.layout: List-view inside a card. Each row is highly dense but clear.
top_prospects.row_structure: Left: Avatar & Name. Middle: 1-2 line AI Chat Summary (italicized, powder-blue background block). Right: Score (Lime pill if > 80), Temperature badge, and 'Open Cockpit' action.
top_prospects.ai_summary_styling: background: rgba(176, 208, 255, 0.2); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--color-gray-900); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-powder-blue);

railway_pipeline_map.concept: Render the CRM sales funnel as a technical railway signalling map.
railway_pipeline_map.background: Dark block (var(--color-near-black)) to mimic a control terminal, creating massive contrast against the off-white dashboard.

css_rules.container: background: #111; padding: 32px 24px; border-radius: 12px; overflow-x: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; color: white;
css_rules.station_node: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 2;
css_rules.station_block: background: var(--color-railway-orange); color: #111; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
css_rules.lead_count: color: var(--color-lime); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; font-family: monospace; margin-top: 8px;

calendar_tasks.layout: Compact 7-day strip (Weekly view) instead of a massive monthly grid.
calendar_tasks.interaction: Clicking a day chip updates the task list below it.
calendar_tasks.styling: Selected day chip: background var(--color-lime), color var(--color-near-black). Task items: small card strips with powder-blue left borders for site visits, gray for calls.

graphs.pipeline_funnel: Horizontal stacked bars. Use Lime, Powder Blue, and neutral grays.
graphs.leads_over_time: Minimalist trend line. Line color: Lime. Area under curve: linear-gradient(Lime to transparent). Hide axis grids for a cleaner look.

activity_feed.layout: Vertical timeline line. Nodes for each activity.
activity_feed.styling: Left border 2px solid var(--color-gray-200). Padding-left 16px. Use powder-blue for email icons, lime for whatsapp/chat.

micro_interactions.buttons: transition: all 0.2s ease; On hover: scale(1.02) for primary actions.
micro_interactions.loading_states: Use skeleton loaders with a subtle shimmer effect (linear-gradient animation) using the powder-blue color at 10% opacity.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The tech stack is Vanilla JS SPA with Laravel Blade. DO NOT use React, Vue, or Tailwind. You must use native CSS or the existing app.css file.
DOM rendering is handled via `CRM.el(tag, attributes, children)` helper in `dashboard.js`. Write your component logic utilizing this helper.
Add styles to `/app/laravel-crm/public/assets/css/app.css`. Use CSS custom properties defined in `colors.css_variables`.
Build the 'Railway Pipeline Map' exactly as described using HTML/CSS (divs and flexbox). No canvas or SVGs required, simple pseudo-elements and flex gaps will achieve the SimSig UI look.
Ensure `data-testid` attributes are passed in the `attributes` object of `CRM.el()` for all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="kpi-card-hot-leads"`).
DO NOT alter the predefined color palette. Maintain the 'Agrocorp CRM' brand: Off-white background, Lime and Powder Blue accents, Manrope font.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do not use generic centered layouts or muddy gradients.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns.
Enforce high contrast (APCA compliant) for text.
Use 2-3x more spacing (padding/margin) than default frameworks to create 'Premium Data Density'.
Micro-animations are mandatory on hover states (excluding universal 'transition: all').
Never use placeholder AI emojis for icons. Use SVGs or the project's existing icon set.
